name: Black Studies
notes: A minimum of six courses (24 credit hours): BLST 110, three divisional courses, two electives.
The three divisional courses must all come from EITHER the humanities OR the social sciences side of the BLST offerings - not auto-enforced.
The six courses must include courses from at least two different disciplines - not auto-enforced (BLST courses are cross-listed from many home departments).
max100Level 3 is the aggregate of the page's per-group caps (BLST 110, at most one 100-level divisional course, at most one 100-level elective).

requirementGroups.label: Divisional courses (3)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Three divisional courses - Students must choose three BLST courses from either the humanities or social sciences. No more than one of these courses can be at the 100-level.

requirementGroups.label: Elective courses (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two elective courses - Students must choose two BLST courses as electives. No more than one of these courses can be at the 100-level.
